description:
4 bedroom, 2+1 bath house, in-ground pool, in-ground pool, sunny south courtyard, garage, nestled at the top of the wooded neighborhood of Sherwood.Fully renovated high-end property in 2012 offering a balance between comfort and serenity. 2km/5 min by car from the Kirkland REM/34 min from McGill Station. Neighboring Windermere Park, schools and hospitals.Maintained since 1991 by the seller, it is turnkey with a bright open area, kitchen with quartz and marble counters. Landscaped courtyard with pool and terraces, very private, in a safe area without traffic.
            Refined living spaces:
            * Large open area: Inviting and bathed in light, showcasing superb hardwood floors.
            * High-end kitchen: Contemporary design with marble dinette counter, quartz surfaces and noble materials, perfect for receptions.
            * Dining room: A fluid transition space to the outdoor terrace thanks to its elegant solid wood patio doors.
            * Master bedroom: A true sanctuary with adjoining private bathroom and large glass shower with a clean design.
            * Four spacious bedrooms and two bathrooms, a completely renovated shower room, one of which has heated floors.
            A private outdoor oasis:
            * South courtyard: Beautifully landscaped and lined with mature trees, creating an oasis of peace without any vis-à-vis.
            * Relaxation areas: Inground pool, vast cedar deck and concrete patio, designed to take full advantage of outdoor living.
            Technical details and conveniences:
            * The roof and all the high quality doors and windows were changed in 2012.
            * Optimal comfort: natural gas heating (high efficiency) and central air conditioning.
            * Integrated single garage and double entrance partly in paving stone.
            * Finished basement with custom storage and cedar closet.
            Inclusions: Pool accessories and maintenance, gas oven, gas oven, washer-dryer, refrigerator, dishwasher, curtains and poles, light fixtures (except exclusion). Living room bay window cushions. PVC wall-mounted garage organization system with brackets
            Exclusions: Furniture and personal effects, lighting in the dining room.

This legal fourplex at 486 Montrose Avenue has been extensively renovated and meticulously maintained, offering a rare combination of strong existing income, vacant units for immediate upside, and outstanding long-term appreciation potential.

The property features four self-contained suites with four separate hydro meters. All units have their own source of heat with no shared air ducts, as well as in-suite W/D, dishwasher and built-in microwave. Two units are currently tenanted, while two vacant units offer the flexibility to select your own tenants at current market rents or occupy one unit yourself while generating substantial income from the others. 

The thoughtfully configured layout includes a spacious 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom basement apartment in a professionally underpinned (8ft ceilings) lower level; a bright 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom main floor suite; a 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom second-floor apartment; and a unique upper two-level 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom suite spanning the second and third floors. In total, the property offers 5 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms across four legal units.

Extensive upgrades and renovations throughout the building deliver turnkey ownership with pride of ownership evident at every turn. Two on-site parking spaces further enhance tenant appeal and owner convenience.

Ideally located steps from Bloor Street and College Street's renowned restaurants, cafés, boutiques, parks, and transit, this vibrant west-end neighbourhood continues to attract quality tenants and homeowners alike. Enjoy easy access to Little Italy, Bickford Park, Christie Pits, Kensington Market, the University of Toronto, and downtown Toronto. Whether you're an investor seeking immediate cash flow and future rental upside or an owner-occupier looking to offset your mortgage with rental income, this is a rare opportunity to acquire a legal, fully upgraded multi-unit property in one of Toronto's most desirable urban communities. Residential-Commercial (RC) zoning provides numerous possibilities for this property's uses.
